impact.text: This makes early bonding curve buyers continue receiving AMM trading fees indefinitely after token graduation.

precondition_sources.text: During the bonding curve phase, the unlocked flag is false.
When the token graduates to AMM trading, the unlock() function is called so that unlocked becomes true.

intent_sources.text: Rewards should stop when the token graduates to automated market maker trading rather than continuing indefinitely.
